rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday family term for a grandfather, especially a paternal grandfather.

example.english: My grandpa used to take me for dim sum all the time.
example.traditional: 我爺爺以前成日帶我去飲茶。
example.jyutping: ngo5 je4 je4 ji5 cin4 seng4 jat6 daai3 ngo5 heoi3 jam2 caa4

rows.note: Use this for a maternal grandfather rather than the usual paternal-side term 爺爺.

example.english: My grandpa lives in Macau and always asks me to go back for dinner.
example.traditional: 我公公住喺澳門，成日叫我返去食飯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gung1 gung1 zyu6 hai2 ou3 mun4 seng4 jat6 giu3 ngo5 faan1 heoi3 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this when addressing or referring respectfully to an elderly man who is not necessarily a relative.

example.traditional: 老伯，呢度唔可以泊車㗎。
example.jyutping: lou5 baak3 ni1 dou6 m4 ho2 ji5 paak3 ce1 gaa3
